 ● Workflow(Migrate all 137 backend features to the typed TypeScript+Go catalog
)
  phases:
    1. Migrate domains — Generate TS + Go feature files per domain in
  parallel
    2. Migrate misc — Generate TS + Go files for flat/PascalCase features
    3. Consolidate — Update catalog.ts to import all new domain files
  Dynamic workflows can use a lot of tokens quickly by running many
  subagents in parallel — which counts against your usage limit. Stop a
  running workflow at any time with /workflows, or disable dynamic workflows
  in /config.
